description: This Java class, ResultFactory, provides factory methods for creating various types of Result objects used in handling command responses, events, and errors within the Orion Eclipse Ditto persistent actors framework.

classes.name: ResultFactory
classes.description: A final utility class offering static methods to generate different Result types, including mutation, error, query, and empty results.

methods.name: newMutationResult
methods.description: Creates a mutation result with specified command, event, response, and optional actor state flags.

methods.name: newErrorResult
methods.description: Creates an error result encapsulating a DittoRuntimeException and the originating command.

methods.name: newQueryResult
methods.description: Creates a query result with the specified command and response headers.

methods.name: emptyResult
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance representing an empty result.
